name: gemini-nano-banana-2.1
description: Nano Banana 2 (Gemini 3.1 Flash Image) is an updated image model designed for efficient generation and conversational editing. It improves visual quality, multi-turn character consistency, and accurate text rendering, while supporting search-grounded generation at 1K, 2K, and 4K resolutions.
zhDescription: Nano Banana 2 (Gemini 3.1 Flash Image) 的更新版本，旨在实现高效的图片生成和对话式智能修图，并改进视觉质量、多轮角色一致性、准确的文本渲染，以及基于搜索的 1K、2K 和 4K 分辨率生成。

usageGuide.authIntro: 使用 API Key 进行认证，在请求头中添加 x-goog-api-key：
usageGuide.requestIntro: 使用 Gemini Generate Content 协议：
usageGuide.docLabel: 查看完整 API 文档

python.code:
# pip install google-genai
from google import genai
from google.genai import types

client = genai.Client(
    api_key="<api_key>",
    http_options=types.HttpOptions(base_url="https://maas-api.antdigital.com"),
)

response = client.models.generate_content(
    model="gemini-nano-banana-2.1",
    contents="What is the meaning of life?",
)
print(response.text)

javascript.installLine: 无需安装额外依赖（需 Node 18+ 或支持 fetch 的运行环境）

curl.installLine: 说明：macOS / Linux 一般已预装 curl
curl.code:
curl -X POST "https://maas-api.antdigital.com/v1beta/models/gemini-nano-banana-2.1:generateContent" \
  -H "x-goog-api-key: <api_key>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"contents":[{"role":"user","parts":[{"text":"What is the meaning of life?"}]}]}'
